title: University of Texas
description: University of Texas's brand palette includes orange-red (#bf5700), white (#ffffff), blue (#333f48), bright orange (#f8971f), light gray (#d6d2c4), soft blue (#9cadb7), blue (#005f86), cyan (#00a9b7), green (#579d42), lime (#a6cd57), and bright amber (#ffd600). Colors are documented in UT's brand center color guidelines.
